subject: 貪欲なる抗窟1
text: Upon entering Greed Hole 1, ignore the magic circle on the right for now and go straight to Greed Hole 2, then return to the previous area and examine the device next to the magic circle to proceed forward.

evidence.quote: ◎**「貪欲なる抗窟1」** へ入ったら、右手の魔方陣はひとまずスルーし**「貪欲なる抗窟2」** へ直進...◎手間のエリアに戻って魔法陣横の装置を調べると先へ進めるようになる
evidence.translation: Upon entering Greed Hole 1, ignore the magic circle on the right for now and go straight to Greed Hole 2, then return to the previous area and examine the device next to the magic circle to proceed forward.

subject: 敗者達の峡谷
text: Valley Blooming Herbs can be gathered from 3 locations in Ravine of the Defeated: near where Giant Spider was, near the second turning point of cliff climbing, and near the rock on the left slightly before the exit.

evidence.quote: ◎**「谷間に咲く薬草」** は**「敗者達の峡谷」** で3ヶ所より採取可能...ジャイアントスパイダーが居た付近・崖登りの2回目の折り返し地点付近・出口少し手前の左側の岩付近
evidence.translation: Valley Blooming Herbs can be gathered from 3 locations in Ravine of the Defeated: near where Giant Spider was, near the second turning point of cliff climbing, and near the rock on the left slightly before the exit.

subject: クリムゾンスピナー
text: Crimson Spinner is in Pilgrim Road of Predators.

evidence.quote: ◎**「クリムゾンスピナー」** は**「捕食者の巡礼路」** にいる
evidence.translation: Crimson Spinner is in Pilgrim Road of Predators.

subject: オーバーレイスライム
text: Proceed along the path and defeat NM Overlay Slime in a sub-event at Serpent Tail Facing the Sky.

evidence.quote: ◎道なりに進み**「空臨む蛇の尻尾」** でサブイベント、NM**「オーバーレイスライム」** を倒す
evidence.translation: Proceed along the path and defeat NM Overlay Slime in a sub-event at Serpent Tail Facing the Sky.

subject: ファットスライム
text: Teleport to Corridor of the Crawling Fool, advance inside to defeat NM Fat Slime and activate switches, and defeating all 3 will activate the central teleporter to Silence Verdant Woodland.

evidence.quote: ◎転移して**「地這う愚者の回廊」** へ、目の前にある転移装置はまだ起動しない為、奥に進みNM**「ファットスライム」** を倒しスイッチを起動させていく...◎3体全て倒せば中央にあった転移装置が動くようになるので**「静寂なる新緑の林道」** へ転移
evidence.translation: Teleport to Corridor of the Crawling Fool, advance inside to defeat NM Fat Slime and activate switches, and defeating all 3 will activate the central teleporter to Silence Verdant Woodland.

subject: ゴブリンリーダー
text: NM Goblin Leader is located in the deepest part of Cave of Laughing Demons immediately down-left from Pioneer Ground of Rampaging War Demons.

evidence.quote: ◎NM**「ゴブリンリーダー」** は**「荒ぶる戦鬼達の開拓地」** からすぐ左下に下りた**「嘲笑いし鬼達の洞穴」** 最奥部にいる
evidence.translation: NM Goblin Leader is located in the deepest part of Cave of Laughing Demons immediately down-left from Pioneer Ground of Rampaging War Demons.

subject: フレアドラゴン
text: To head to the labyrinth, first proceed through the right forest Fragrant Leaves Maze, and after exiting the forest go right to face NM Flare Dragon, triggering a sub-event to search for a weapon to defeat the dragon.

evidence.quote: ◎迷宮区へ向かうには、まず右の森**「芳葉たる迷道」** を進む...◎森を抜けた先で右へ進みNM**「フレアドラゴン」** と対面。ドラゴンを倒すための武器を探すサブイベントを起こす
evidence.translation: To head to the labyrinth, first proceed through the right forest Fragrant Leaves Maze, and after exiting the forest go right to face NM Flare Dragon, triggering a sub-event to search for a weapon to defeat the dragon.

subject: 竜破石
text: Defeat Iron Golem in the northwest to obtain key item Dragon Buster Stone, return and give it to NPC Elliot to obtain Dragon Buster Sword, and defeating NM Flare Dragon allows progress forward.

evidence.quote: ◎北西にいる**「アイアンゴーレム」** を倒し貴重品**「竜破石」** を入手...◎戻ってNPCエリオットに渡すと _『竜破剣』_ を入手、それからNM**「フレアドラゴン」** を倒すと先へ進めるようになる
evidence.translation: Defeat Iron Golem in the northwest to obtain key item Dragon Buster Stone, return and give it to NPC Elliot to obtain Dragon Buster Sword, and defeating NM Flare Dragon allows progress forward.

subject: 許されざる歌声
text: For the quest Unforgivable Song, only Sirens from Slope of the Kneeling Sunset right outside Floor 79 count as targets.

evidence.quote: ◎クエスト _『許されざる歌声』_ の**「セイレーン」** は、79層出てすぐの**「平伏せし落陽の勾配」** の敵のみが対象
evidence.translation: For the quest Unforgivable Song, only Sirens from Slope of the Kneeling Sunset right outside Floor 79 count as targets.

subject: ザインリザードマン
text: NM Zain Lizardman is in the immediate vicinity of Lake Path of Bundled Cascades.

evidence.quote: ◎NM**「ザインリザードマン」** は**「束ねし瀑布の湖道」** のすぐ近くにいる
evidence.translation: NM Zain Lizardman is in the immediate vicinity of Lake Path of Bundled Cascades.

subject: 嘆く犠牲の留置所
text: Because keys in Detention of Lamenting Victims are placed randomly on each floor, you must search all treasure chests.

evidence.quote: ◎**「嘆く犠牲の留置所」** の鍵は各フロアでランダムに配置されている為、宝箱を調べ尽くすしかない
evidence.translation: Because keys in Detention of Lamenting Victims are placed randomly on each floor, you must search all treasure chests.

subject: ダークネス
text: NM Darkness is in Road of Fleeing Dead Spirits before the labyrinth.

evidence.quote: ◎NM**「ダークネス」** は迷宮区前の**「亡者が逃げ惑いし道」** にいる
evidence.translation: NM Darkness is in Road of Fleeing Dead Spirits before the labyrinth.

subject: 砂漠に散った無数の命
text: For the quest Deadly Desert, only Scorpions from Desert of Sun-Drenched Heat Waves right outside Floor 81 count as targets.

evidence.quote: ◎クエスト _『砂漠に散った無数の命』_ の**「スコーピオン」** は、81層出てすぐの**「陽光注ぐ熱波の砂漠」** の敵のみが対象
evidence.translation: For the quest Deadly Desert, only Scorpions from Desert of Sun-Drenched Heat Waves right outside Floor 81 count as targets.

subject: 封印されし蜃気楼の砂地
text: Clear the four ruins visible from Sealed Mirage Sands by defeating Shadow Demon in the deepest part of each ruin, and defeating all 4 Shadow Demons removes the roadblock obstacle, allowing progress to the labyrinth.

evidence.quote: ◎**「封印されし蜃気楼の砂地」** から見える４つの遺跡を攻略していく。各遺跡の最奥部にいる**「シャドウデーモン」** を倒せば良い...◎**「シャドウデーモン」** 4体を倒すと通行止めオブジェクトが消え、迷宮区攻略へ
evidence.translation: Clear the four ruins visible from Sealed Mirage Sands by defeating Shadow Demon in the deepest part of each ruin, and defeating all 4 Shadow Demons removes the roadblock obstacle, allowing progress to the labyrinth.

subject: ブレイザーデーモン
text: NM Blazer Demon is in Trial of Malice-Drifting Annihilation on the west front, and the key for Trial of Mocking Mimicry is in the middle chest of the upper-right small room.

evidence.quote: ◎NM**「ブレイザーデーモン」** は西側手前の**「邪気漂う殲滅の試練」** にいる...◎**「嘲笑せし擬態の試練」** の鍵は右上の小部屋・真ん中の宝箱。他はミミックと武器宝箱
evidence.translation: NM Blazer Demon is in Trial of Malice-Drifting Annihilation on the west front, and the key for Trial of Mocking Mimicry is in the middle chest of the upper-right small room.

subject: グレーターバンディット
text: Seven Light Polar Stones can be gathered at 3 spots in Crystal Seat of Intersecting Twin Walls, and NM Greater Bandit is below the cliff of Crystal Seat of Intersecting Twin Walls.

evidence.quote: ◎**「七光極石」** は**「双壁の交叉する晶座」** で3ヶ所より採取可能...◎NM**「グレーターバンディット」** は**「双壁の交叉する晶座」** の崖下にいる
evidence.translation: Seven Light Polar Stones can be gathered at 3 spots in Crystal Seat of Intersecting Twin Walls, and NM Greater Bandit is below the cliff of Crystal Seat of Intersecting Twin Walls.

subject: 渦巻く旋流の積層
text: Press the respective switches in the depths of Cliff Corridor to the Deep 2 from above the cliff, and in the depths of Cliff Corridor to the Deep 4 from below the cliff.

evidence.quote: ◎崖上から**「深き地へ至る崖廊2」** の奥、崖下から**「深き地へ至る崖廊4」** の奥それぞれのスイッチを押せば良い
evidence.translation: Press the respective switches in the depths of Cliff Corridor to the Deep 2 from above the cliff, and in the depths of Cliff Corridor to the Deep 4 from below the cliff.

subject: フィアーツリー
text: NM Fear Tree is in Woodland Path of Protecting Trees heading west from Crossroads of Fierce Travelers on Floor 83.

evidence.quote: ◎NM**「フィアーツリー」** は83層の**「猛き旅人の分かれ道」** から西へ進んだ**「護りし樹木達の林道」** にいる
evidence.translation: NM Fear Tree is in Woodland Path of Protecting Trees heading west from Crossroads of Fierce Travelers on Floor 83.

subject: 賢しき鬼達の集落
text: The key to advance from Settlement of Clever Demons 1 is the Commercial District Key at the far upper-right, and keys to advance from Settlement of Clever Demons 2 are the Hall Key at the far left and King's Key at the far upper-right.

evidence.quote: ◎**「賢しき鬼達の集落1」** から先に進む鍵は一番右上の**「商業区の鍵」**...◎**「賢しき鬼達の集落2」** から先に進む鍵は左端の**「広間の鍵」** と、一番右上の**「王の鍵」**
evidence.translation: The key to advance from Settlement of Clever Demons 1 is the Commercial District Key at the far upper-right, and keys to advance from Settlement of Clever Demons 2 are the Hall Key at the far left and King's Key at the far upper-right.

subject: アントプリンセス
text: NM Ant Princess is in the deepest part of Road Connecting to the Ruler reached by going lower-right from entrance to Gouged Cavern 2 and heading straight, and on labyrinth 2F and 3F you form a party with Strea, with no treasure chests on 2F.

evidence.quote: ◎NM**「アントプリンセス」** は、入り口から右下⇒**「抉られた岩洞2」** と進み、直進していった先の**「統べし者へ連なる道」** の最奥部にいる...◎迷宮区2階・3階はストレアとパーティーを組むことになる。2階は宝箱なし
evidence.translation: NM Ant Princess is in the deepest part of Road Connecting to the Ruler reached by going lower-right from entrance to Gouged Cavern 2 and heading straight, and on labyrinth 2F and 3F you form a party with Strea, with no treasure chests on 2F.

subject: オークジェネラル
text: To proceed through the west forest Bewildering Tree of Wandering right outside Floor 85, you must first defeat Orc General on the east side of east forest Woodland Path of Rustling Fertility.

evidence.quote: ◎85層出てすぐからの西の森**「惑わせし彷徨の迷樹」** を進むには、先に東の森**「さざめく豊穣の林道」** 東側にいる**「オークジェネラル」** を倒す必要がある
evidence.translation: To proceed through the west forest Bewildering Tree of Wandering right outside Floor 85, you must first defeat Orc General on the east side of east forest Woodland Path of Rustling Fertility.

subject: 迷いの森から来た男
text: For the quest Bewildering Forest, only Orc Warriors in Woodland Path of Rustling Fertility count as targets.

evidence.quote: ◎クエスト _『迷いの森から来た男』_ の**「オークウォーリア」** は**「さざめく豊穣の林道」** の敵のみが対象
evidence.translation: For the quest Bewildering Forest, only Orc Warriors in Woodland Path of Rustling Fertility count as targets.

subject: エメラルドドラゴン
text: NM Emerald Dragon is in the deepest part of cave Dwelling of the Hunted Hermit to the west of Lakeside of Wavering Illusions.

evidence.quote: ◎NM**「エメラルドドラゴン」** は**「幻燈のたゆたう湖畔」** の西にある洞窟**「追われし隠者の棲家」** 最奥部にいる
evidence.translation: NM Emerald Dragon is in the deepest part of cave Dwelling of the Hunted Hermit to the west of Lakeside of Wavering Illusions.

subject: アンデッドはふたたび
text: For the quest The Undead Return, only Lost Soldiers in Valley Where Soldiers Walked right outside Floor 86 count as targets.

evidence.quote: ◎クエスト _『アンデッドはふたたび』_ の**「ロストソルジャー」** は86層出てすぐの**「兵士達が歩みし谷」** の敵のみが対象
evidence.translation: For the quest The Undead Return, only Lost Soldiers in Valley Where Soldiers Walked right outside Floor 86 count as targets.

subject: ネクロマンサー
text: NM Necromancer is in the deepest part of Fortress of Living Corpses beyond Ancient Battlefield of Bleeding Fierce Combat.

evidence.quote: ◎NM**「ネクロマンサー」** は**「血を流す激戦の古戦場」** の先にある**「生ける屍達の砦」** 最奥部にいる
evidence.translation: NM Necromancer is in the deepest part of Fortress of Living Corpses beyond Ancient Battlefield of Bleeding Fierce Combat.

subject: ナイトストーカー
text: NM Nightstalker is in the upper-left of Ancient Underground Fortress after exiting Chained Stratified Cavern Lower Layer.

evidence.quote: ◎NM**「ナイトストーカー」** は**「連鎖する積層の岩窟 下層」** を出た先にある**「地底に眠る古の城塞」** 左上にいる
evidence.translation: NM Nightstalker is in the upper-left of Ancient Underground Fortress after exiting Chained Stratified Cavern Lower Layer.

subject: インビジブル
text: For labyrinth missions, crossing in front of target monsters on floors other than 1F results in failure, so using battle skill Invisible makes clearing easier.

evidence.quote: ◎迷宮区ミッションは、1階以外だと対象モンスターの前を横切るとアウトなのでバトルスキル**「インビジブル」** を使用するとクリアしやすいだろう
evidence.translation: For labyrinth missions, crossing in front of target monsters on floors other than 1F results in failure, so using battle skill Invisible makes clearing easier.

subject: ネクロドラゴン
text: In Dragon Seal Ruins, both ends follow the flow of pressing switch -> defeating inner NM -> opening door and destroying crystal, after which defeat NM Necro Dragon in the central chamber.

evidence.quote: ◎封竜遺跡は、両端とも スイッチを押す⇒奥のNMを倒す⇒扉を開けクリスタルを壊す の流れ。その後、中央の間のNM**「ネクロドラゴン」** を倒す
evidence.translation: In Dragon Seal Ruins, both ends follow the flow of pressing switch -> defeating inner NM -> opening door and destroying crystal, after which defeat NM Necro Dragon in the central chamber.

subject: グラトニーラフレシア
text: NM Gluttony Rafflesia is in Cool Shaded Rain Rifts ahead.

evidence.quote: ◎NM**「グラトニーラフレシア」** はその先の**「冷涼なる日陰の雨裂」** にいる
evidence.translation: NM Gluttony Rafflesia is in Cool Shaded Rain Rifts ahead.

subject: 塔を守るトカゲ
object: エルダーリザードマン
text: For quest Tower of Lizards, only Elder Lizardmen in Single Tower Controlling Torrents count as targets.

evidence.quote: ◎クエスト**「塔を守るトカゲ」** のエルダーリザードマンは、**「奔流を御す片塔」** の敵のみが対象
evidence.translation: For quest Tower of Lizards, only Elder Lizardmen in Single Tower Controlling Torrents count as targets.

subject: ブレイズアーマー
object: 天空へ誘う浮き雲の回廊
text: NM Blaze Armor is in the deepest part of Floating Cloud Corridor Inviting to the Sky reached after clearing the twin towers.

evidence.quote: ◎NM**「ブレイズアーマー」** は双塔クリア後に飛ぶ**「天空へ誘う浮き雲の回廊」** 最奥部にいる
evidence.translation: NM Blaze Armor is in the deepest part of Floating Cloud Corridor Inviting to the Sky reached after clearing the twin towers.

subject: インプレグナブル
object: 空仰ぐ草木の浮遊大陸3
text: NM Impregnable is in Floating Continent of Sky-Facing Vegetation 3.

evidence.quote: ◎NM**「インプレグナブル」** は**「空仰ぐ草木の浮遊大陸3」** にいる
evidence.translation: NM Impregnable is in Floating Continent of Sky-Facing Vegetation 3.

subject: ハチミツ
text: For Honey on the hill right outside Floor 90, if 5 cannot be gathered in one day, return and rest at the inn to advance the day before gathering again.

evidence.quote: ◎（90層出てすぐの丘にある**「ハチミツ」** は、一日で5個集まらなければ一旦戻り、宿屋で日をまたいでから再採取しよう）
evidence.translation: For Honey on the hill right outside Floor 90, if 5 cannot be gathered in one day, return and rest at the inn to advance the day before gathering again.

subject: 泡沫たる空虚の迷道
text: Warp route Left->Left yields Gray-White Ore x10, Left->Right->Left->Right yields mob weapon x1 and mimic, and Left->Right->Left->Left->Right meets the woman to receive the stone to insert into Wind Corridor of Gathering Magic Seals.

evidence.quote: ◎ワープ経路は _『左⇒左』_ で灰白鉱x10、 _『左⇒右⇒左⇒右』_ で使用中の種類のモブ武器x1・ミミック...◎道なりに次の**「魔印の集積する風廊」** まで進み石をハメ込んでいく
evidence.translation: Warp route Left->Left yields Gray-White Ore x10, Left->Right->Left->Right yields mob weapon x1 and mimic, and Left->Right->Left->Left->Right meets the woman to receive the stone to insert into Wind Corridor of Gathering Magic Seals.

subject: ロードオブウィンド
object: 俊敏なる飛竜の巣 上層
text: NM Lord of Wind is in Agile Wyvern Nest Upper Layer down-left from Middle Layer; defeat nearby Red Blast, then return to Spiral Path to Abyss Green and go to Windless Abyss Green to defeat Red Blast again to reach the labyrinth.

evidence.quote: ◎NM**「ロードオブウィンド」** は中層から左下へ進んだ**「俊敏なる飛竜の巣 上層」** にいる...◎最初の**「深淵の緑地への螺旋道」** へ戻り、右側のエリア**「風なき深淵の緑地」** へ進むと**「レッドブラスト」** と再戦。倒して迷宮区へ
evidence.translation: NM Lord of Wind is in Agile Wyvern Nest Upper Layer down-left from Middle Layer; defeat nearby Red Blast, then return to Spiral Path to Abyss Green and go to Windless Abyss Green to defeat Red Blast again to reach the labyrinth.

subject: 迷宮区1階
text: In labyrinth 1F, bring the normal teleport stone from the right end to the broken teleport stone on the left end, and exchange it to teleport to 2F.

evidence.quote: ◎迷宮区1階の右端に＜正常な転移石＞があるので、左端の壊れた転移石の所まで持って行き、交換して2階へ転移
evidence.translation: In labyrinth 1F, bring the normal teleport stone from the right end to the broken teleport stone on the left end, and exchange it to teleport to 2F.

subject: ヘブンリィソード
object: 94層・隠された古代の宝物庫 東
text: NM Heavenly Sword is in Floor 94 Hidden Ancient Treasure Vault East and NM Inferno Sword is in Floor 94 Hidden Ancient Treasure Vault West, where teleport crystals cannot be used.

evidence.quote: ◎NM**「ヘブンリィソード」** は**「94層・隠された古代の宝物庫 東」** 、NMインフェルノソード」は**「94層・隠された古代の宝物庫 西」** にいる...◎注：宝物庫のみ転移結晶の使用不可
evidence.translation: NM Heavenly Sword is in Floor 94 Hidden Ancient Treasure Vault East and NM Inferno Sword is in Floor 94 Hidden Ancient Treasure Vault West, where teleport crystals cannot be used.

subject: 双璧の交わる戦場
text: NM Gaia Breaker is in Forest Filled with Deep Sleep; after defeating it, return to the cave and go upper-right to gather Flower of Life in Battlefield of Intersecting Twin Walls.

evidence.quote: ◎**「深き眠りに満ちた森林」** にNM**「ガイアブレイカー」** がいる...**「双璧の交わる戦場」** で**「命の花」** が採取可能
evidence.translation: NM Gaia Breaker is in Forest Filled with Deep Sleep; after defeating it, return to the cave and go upper-right to gather Flower of Life in Battlefield of Intersecting Twin Walls.

subject: 策謀なる転の回廊
text: Corridor of Scheming Turn is a puzzle: answer from the start is left 1, 3, right 4, 4 in order, leading to labyrinth exploration.

evidence.quote: ◎**「策謀なる転の回廊」** は謎解き。（答え：最初から順に左から1、3、右から4、4）⇒迷宮区攻略
evidence.translation: Corridor of Scheming Turn is a puzzle: answer from the start is left 1, 3, right 4, 4 in order, leading to labyrinth exploration.

subject: アルベリヒ
text: Entering the map triggers a sub-event battle with Lv200 Alberich; for quest Defeat That Knight!, Rune Knights spawn only one at a time on Path of Labyrinth Eaters right outside Floor 97, so wait for respawns after defeating them.

evidence.quote: ◎マップ入ってすぐサブイベント、Lv200**「アルベリヒ」** と戦闘...◎クエスト _『あの騎士を討て!』_ の**「ルーンナイト」** は97層出てすぐの**「迷宮を食らう者達の道」** に1体ずつしか沸かないので、倒したら沸き待ち
evidence.translation: Entering the map triggers a sub-event battle with Lv200 Alberich; for quest Defeat That Knight!, Rune Knights spawn only one at a time on Path of Labyrinth Eaters right outside Floor 97, so wait for respawns after defeating them.

subject: 紅玉彩る剣の塔2階
text: In Ruby Adorned Sword Tower 2F, pressing switches in order of right-middle -> upper-right -> left-middle opens the door to advance forward.

evidence.quote: ◎**「紅玉彩る剣の塔2階」** は右真ん中⇒右上⇒左真ん中の順にスイッチを押せば先へ進む扉が開く
evidence.translation: In Ruby Adorned Sword Tower 2F, pressing switches in order of right-middle -> upper-right -> left-middle opens the door to advance forward.

subject: 100層紅玉宮
text: Floor 100 Ruby Palace: No field, 4 consecutive battles, and after 4 consecutive battles you receive an individual ending with the girl chosen as your partner.

evidence.quote: **【100層紅玉宮】**...4連戦。...4連戦後にパートナーとして選んだ子と個別エンディング。
evidence.translation: Floor 100 Ruby Palace: No field, 4 consecutive battles, and after 4 consecutive battles you receive an individual ending with the girl chosen as your partner.

subject: ピナ
text: Free -> hit rate up, HP recovery; Preserve Life -> defense up, status abnormality recovery; Reliable -> attack up, defense up; Versatile -> attack up, speed up; Helpful -> SP recovery, status abnormality recovery; Support -> speed up, SP recovery.

evidence.quote: 【自由】→命中率アップ、HP回復...【サポート】→速度アップ、SP回復
evidence.translation: Free -> hit rate up, HP recovery; Preserve Life -> defense up, status abnormality recovery; Reliable -> attack up, defense up; Versatile -> attack up, speed up; Helpful -> SP recovery, status abnormality recovery; Support -> speed up, SP recovery.

subject: ピナ
text: Gray-White Crystal -> hit rate up... Diamond Crystal -> defense up; Keen Blade Crystal -> status abnormality recovery; level up with 100 stones or 20 minerals or 10 crystals.

evidence.quote: 【灰白晶】→命中率アップ...【金剛晶】→防御力アップ...石100個 or 鉱20個 or 晶10個 でレベルアップ。
evidence.translation: Gray-White Crystal -> hit rate up... Diamond Crystal -> defense up; Keen Blade Crystal -> status abnormality recovery; level up with 100 stones or 20 minerals or 10 crystals.

subject: 友好度
text: RANK5 0~14 [-], RANK4 15~99 [Acquaintance], RANK3 100~299 [Good Friends], RANK2 300~499 [Intimate], RANK1 500 [Peerless].

subject: 友好度
text: When RANK reaches 3, "Talk" and "Walk the city together" options are added; when RANK reaches 2, "Form party" and "Gift weapon" options are added; when Friendship reaches 400 or more, "Gift armor" option is added.

evidence.quote: RANKが3になると、「会話する」、「一緒に街を歩こう」の項目が追加される...友好度が400以上になると、「防具をプレゼント」の項目が追加される
evidence.translation: When RANK reaches 3, "Talk" and "Walk the city together" options are added; when RANK reaches 2, "Form party" and "Gift weapon" options are added; when Friendship reaches 400 or more, "Gift armor" option is added.
